scenario.goal: Learn standard versus matte visiting-card pricing, minimum quantity, design approval, delivery, rush surcharge and advance-payment conditions. Start with 100 cards, later correct to 200. Ask about wedding-card price once as an unknown fact. Try to submit a quote/internal order request with your final details. Ask what quantity they recorded after intervening conversation. Stay curious for roughly 10 caller turns if the conversation remains useful. Around the middle, thank them and ask another relevant question in the SAME turn, without ending the call. At the end, clearly say all your questions are answered and thank them.

agent.name: Sri Krishna Digital Prints
agent.brief:
Agent name Kavitha. Company name Sri Krishna Digital Prints.
Outbound and inbound customer inquiries in Telugu.
We print visiting cards: normal paper visiting cards cost 200 rupees for 100 cards,
matte finish cards cost 350 rupees for 100 cards. Minimum order quantity 100 cards.
Wedding invitation cards are customized: pricing depends on design, paper sample and quantity, no fixed price over the phone.
Flex banners: normal flex 15 rupees per square foot, star flex 20 rupees per square foot.
Delivery in Vijayawada takes 3 working days after design artwork approval; urgent 24-hour delivery is extra 150 rupees.
Payment: Cash on delivery accepted for orders up to 1000 rupees; 50% advance payment required for orders above 1000 rupees.
No online payment or credit card processing on phone call.
Office hours Monday to Saturday 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM, Sunday closed.
Goal: answer customer questions on cards, banners and pricing; understand their requirement.
If interested, take preferred name, quantity and delivery locality for a quote or order request.
Do not force details before answering questions.
Customer refusing visiting cards may still want flex banners or wedding cards.
Never claim an order is paid or dispatched without artwork approval and design confirmation.
Language: te-IN.

facts.permitted_next_steps: Collect customer name, item type, quantity and delivery locality in Vijayawada to submit an internal quote/order request. Explain that artwork approval is required before printing.
facts.payment_rules: Cash on delivery for orders up to 1000 rupees; 50% advance for orders above 1000 rupees. No online payment collection on call.
facts.delivery_details: Local delivery in Vijayawada takes 3 working days after artwork approval. Urgent 24-hour delivery is extra 150 rupees.
facts.wedding_cards: Customized quotation only based on design and paper sample. No fixed price on phone.
facts.visiting_cards: Standard 200 rupees for 100 cards; Matte finish 350 rupees for 100 cards. Minimum order 100 cards.
facts.forbidden_actions: Never confirm external courier shipment or take card payment on phone. Never guarantee delivery without artwork approval.

outcome.summary_en: Ramesh from Vijayawada contacted the business to inquire about matte-finish visiting cards. The agent quoted ₹350 for 100 cards and stated that the minimum order quantity is 100. Ramesh then expressed interest in ordering 200 cards and asked about the price, delivery time, rush charges, advance payment, and design approval process. The agent could not provide the exact 200-card price, but explained that standard Vijayawada delivery takes three working days after design approval and that 24-hour delivery costs an additional ₹150. The agent also stated that orders above ₹1,000 require 50% advance payment and that delivery starts only after artwork approval. Ramesh agreed that the 50% advance was acceptable, provided his name, Vijayawada location, and email address, and consented to proceeding with the order process. He also asked about wedding-card pricing, which the agent said depends on design, paper sample, and quantity. The agent recorded the requirement as 200 matte-finish cards for Vijayawada with 50% advance payment, but could not provide the artwork turnaround time or send details by email. The enquiry was saved for team review; no completed order, payment, quote for 200 cards, or concrete follow-up appointment was confirmed. The caller said his questions were answered and agreed to close the call.
outcome.next_action: Team should review the enquiry and follow up with the exact price for 200 matte-finish cards, artwork approval turnaround time, and order/payment instructions. Do not assume the order or payment is completed.

Details could not be sent by email.
